page.layout: One page of text in one column; running head at top with page number; headings and verse-like short lines in the middle; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: creaturæ purgationem mentis & corporis, per Dominum nostrum. Ut si quæ illis advenientium spirituum inhærere reliquiæ vel maculæ, ad tactum olei hujus sanctificati abscedant, nullus spiritualibus nequitiis locus, nulla refugii sit facultas, nulla infidiantib' malis latendi lacetia relinquatur: sed venientibus ad fidem servis tuis, & Sancti spiritus tui operatione mundandis, fit unctionis hujus præparatio utilis ad salutem, &c.
main_text.head: Ad oleum:
Ad balsamum:
Et ad chrisma:
CANDELARUM, IN DIE purificationis.
main_text.p: Domine Jesu Christe, fili Dei vivi, benedic candelas istas supplicationibus nostris, infunde eis Domine per virtutem sanctæ cru-

page.notes: The heading "CANDELARUM" is printed as such (for Candelarum). Text ends at a line cut off at the bottom edge ("cru-"). Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably the verse lines of the oil, balsam and chrism sections, and the ends of several lines; readings there are approximate.
